name: zenpilot
description: Let Claude drive the Zen browser: tabs, reading pages, clicking and typing, behind a site allowlist.
long_description: On first use, a macOS dialog asks which Zen profile Claude should use: a separate, logged-out profile zenpilot creates, or your own. zenpilot then starts Zen with remote debugging (offering to reopen it if it's already open) and controls it over WebDriver BiDi. Sites must be allowed first: a dialog asks when Claude needs a new one. Requires Zen in /Applications. Settings: ~/.config/zenpilot/config.toml.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs with ids. The active tab is marked with *.

tools.name: new_tab
tools.description: Open a new tab (it becomes active), optionally loading url.

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Make a tab the active one.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Load url in a tab and wait for the page to finish loading.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Outline of the page's visible interactive elements and text.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by ref (from read_page) with a real mouse event.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Replace the content of a field (by ref) with text using real key events.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page with the mouse wheel by amount pixels.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the visible part of a tab.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Readable main text of the page (prefers <main> or a single <article>).

tools.name: report_limitation
tools.description: Tell the zenpilot developers about something you couldn't do in Zen with these tools.
